versions.label: Deterministic mix
versions.line: The data melody and bands (FluidSynth), model-written harmony and the three recorded Earth voices. The reference.

versions.label: MuseControlLite, mode A
versions.line: Generated audio alone: Stable Audio Open with MuseControlLite adapters, steered by the data melody, dynamics and rhythm.

fidelity.note: Measured on the generated audio alone.

versions.label: MuseControlLite, mode B (augment)
versions.line: Every current stem plus the generated audio as a bed, 13 dB under the data melody.

fidelity.control_kind: shuffled lead through the whole pipeline

versions.label: MuseControlLite, mode B (replace)
versions.line: Data melody, bands and events plus the generated bed, which replaces the model harmony and recorded voices.

fidelity.control_kind: shuffled lead through the whole pipeline

versions.label: Mood layer (Magenta RT 2)
versions.line: The deterministic mix plus a texture from Magenta RealTime 2, steered by SigLIP frame weights and the data curves, 14 dB under the melody.

versions.label: MuseControlLite B+ (no cymbals, with Earth voices)
versions.line: The data melody, bands and every recorded Earth voice at their arranged levels, with a MuseControlLite accompaniment (bass kept) in place of the model harmony. Cymbals removed from the generated part only.

fidelity.control_kind: shuffled lead through the whole pipeline

versions.label: Shuffled control
versions.line: The same arrangement with the melody's notes shuffled in time. It should sound like music but no longer follow the data.

fidelity.note: R² of the shuffled melody against the real data.
